cards.text: Friend, the word of the LORD comes to a man named Hosea son of Beeri, at a time when God's people have two kingdoms, Judah and Israel. Hosea's time stretches across FOUR of Judah's kings: Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah. Over in Israel, the king is Jeroboam son of Jehoash.
Then the LORD first speaks through Hosea. Most people's first assignment is a name tag and a password reset, but Hosea's is this: go, marry a prostitute and have children of adultery.

cards.question: The LORD gives Hosea a reason for this marriage. What is it?

answers.text: The land is departing from the LORD
Hosea has been hiding from the LORD
The kings have stopped praying to the LORD

cards.question: After the LORD tells Hosea to take a prostitute as his wife, Hosea pushes back and refuses to go.

cards.text: Hosea goes and marries Gomer daughter of Diblaim. Friend, some folks get asked to switch desks at work and need a WHOLE meeting about it. Hosea gets asked this, and Hosea goes.
Gomer gives Hosea a son, and the LORD tells Hosea to name him Jezreel. Soon, the LORD says, He'll bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, a former king of Israel (2 Kings 9:6).

cards.question: Along with bringing bloodshed on the house of Jehu, what does the LORD say He'll put an end to?
On that day, the LORD says, He'll break the bow of Israel in the Valley of ___.

cards.text: Gomer has a daughter next, and the LORD says to name her Lo-ruhamah. The reason, He says, is that He'll no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that He should ever forgive them.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll have no compassion on the house of Judah either.
The LORD says He'll save the house of Judah. How will they be saved?

answers.text: By bow and sword in battle

cards.text: After Gomer weans Lo-ruhamah, she has another son. I bet Hosea holds his breath for this name, friend, the way I held mine every time that junk drawer slid open.

cards.question: The LORD tells Hosea to name the boy Lo-ammi, because Israel is not His people and He is not their God.

cards.text: Not My people. Oof, friend. That's a HEAVY place to pull this batch out, but Hosea's story is still in the oven.

findings.problem: Card 6 already names the son Jezreel and tells of 'the bloodshed of Jezreel' just before this card. That gives away the blank 'Valley of ___' and rules out Elah and Hinnom, so the card tests nothing the baker has to reason out. Ask a different question about verse 5, such as what the LORD will break, or fold verse 5 into a story card.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: Hosea 1:9 says 'for you are not My people, and I am not your God.' The text says 'you' and never names Israel. The statement turns 'you' into 'Israel is not His people,' which decides who is being spoken to when the text leaves it open. Keep the text's 'you,' for example: 'because you are not My people, and I am not your God.'

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
